observation: After v0.12.54 made per-check overflow fail closed, fresh main still silently erased some malformed browser assertions: false/null containers could collapse to empty arrays through || fallbacks, empty strings were filtered away, and non-string items were coerced with String(). That allowed an explicitly malformed required assertion plan to be weakened before observation.
changes: Treat explicitly supplied requiredSelectors/selectors and requiredText containers as arrays rather than collapsing false/null malformed values to empty plans.
Require each selector and required-text item to already be a non-empty string instead of coercing arbitrary values or filtering empty strings away.
Preserve deduplication, the v0.12.54 budgets, URL validation, CDP behavior, browser evaluation, screenshots, and receipts.
